Specials available in the model formula

Source: R/spec.R
jd3_specials.Rd

Specials are used on the right-hand side of the formula of X13(), TRAMOSEATS(), REGARIMA() or TRAMO(), e.g. X13(y ~ transform(fun = "Log") + xreg(strike)). Each one records a call to a function of rjd3toolkit that is applied to the base specification (the spec argument).

Specials

  • spec(x): base specification (name or specification object); equivalent to the spec argument of X13(), TRAMOSEATS(), REGARIMA() or TRAMO().

  • basic(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_basic().

  • transform(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_transform().

  • estimate(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_estimate().

  • automodel(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_automodel().

  • outlier(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_outlier().

  • add_outlier(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::add_outlier() (e.g. type = "AO", date = "2020-04-01").

  • easter(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_easter().

  • tradingdays(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_tradingdays().

  • arima(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_arima().

  • ramp(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::add_ramp().

  • usrdefvar(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::add_usrdefvar().

  • x11(...): arguments passed to rjd3x13::set_x11() (X-11 decomposition parameters; use with X13() only).

  • seats(...): arguments passed to rjd3tramoseats::set_seats() (SEATS decomposition parameters; use with TRAMOSEATS() only).

  • benchmarking(...): arguments passed to rjd3toolkit::set_benchmarking() (use with X13() or TRAMOSEATS() only).

  • xreg(..., regeffect = NULL, group = "r", lag = 0, coef = NULL): user-defined regressors taken from columns of the tsibble and added to the context. By default (regeffect = NULL), the regressors are only added to the context (with the group="r"). If regeffect is equals to "Undefined", "Trend", "Seasonal", "Irregular", "Series" or "SeasonallyAdjusted" then variable is also added to the specification using the rjd3toolkit::add_usrdefvar() function with the parameters lag and coeff. If regeffect = "Calendar", then the variable is added to the specification using the rjd3toolkit::set_tradingdays() function.

Precedence

The base spec is applied first, then the specials in a fixed order (basic, transform, estimate, automodel, outlier, add_outlier, easter, tradingdays, arima, ramp, usrdefvar, benchmarking, x11, seats), then xreg(). Later settings override earlier ones. A special that does not apply to the method (e.g. x11() in TRAMOSEATS()) is ignored with a warning.
